deep.reconstruction:
Setting, from the previous pages: X is a space, I an ordered set, and i ↦ X_i an increasing map from I to the closed subsets of X. For each r, I_{Δ_r} is the set of flags i_* = (i_0 ≤ … ≤ i_r) in I. The space X_{Δ_r} ⊂ X × I_{Δ_r} is the set of pairs (x, i_*) with x ∈ X_{i_0}. So X_{Δ_r} = ⨿_{i_*} X_{i_0} × {i_*}, and the component over i_* is written X_{i_*} = X_{i_0} × {i_*}. A monotone map α : Δ_{r'} → Δ_r acts by α^*(x, i_*) = (x, i_* ∘ α), giving a simplicial ("semi-simplicial") space X_{Δ_*}.

In modern terms this is exactly the Bousfield–Kan simplicial replacement of the functor F : I → Closed(X) ⊂ Top: srep(F)_r = ⨿ over i_0 ≤ … ≤ i_r of F(i_0). Its realization is hocolim_I F. Equivalently, it is the chain-indexed part of a Čech nerve: for a chain, X_{i_0} ∩ … ∩ X_{i_r} = X_{i_0}.

The claims on this page:
(16), written (15) on the page: if α(0) = 0, then α^* : X_{Δ_r} → X_{Δ_{r'}} is a morphism of étale coverings. The reason is that (i_* ∘ α)_0 = i_0. So α^* sends the component X_{i_0} × {i_*} identically onto X_{i'_0} × {i'_*}, where i'_* = α^*(i_*). In particular X_{Δ_r} → X_{Δ_0}, (x, i_*) ↦ (x, i_0), is a trivial covering.
(17) The preimage of a component X_{i'_*} is X_{i'_*} × {i_* ∈ I_{Δ_r} | α^*(i_*) = i'_*}. This is the constant covering whose fibre is the set of flags lifting i'_*.
For general α, i.e. α(0) ≠ 0 (essentially the face d_0), he claims only that α^* is a 'local homeomorphism'. In particular (18) claims that X_{Δ_r} → X is a local homeomorphism.

Purpose: to encode a space with a closed filtration or stratification by a semi-simplicial space whose structure maps are as 'étale' as possible. The next page then tries to recover X as the cokernel X_{Δ_0} ⊔_{X_{Δ_1}} X_{Δ_0}, i.e. as a colimit or descent datum. This belongs to the 'topos stratifié' project: describing a stratified space or topos through étale-type gluing data.
errors: The claim that general semi-simplicial operations, and (18) X_{Δ_r} → X, are 'homéomorphismes locaux' is false with the stated hypothesis that the X_i are closed subsets. On a component, X_{Δ_r} → X is the closed inclusion X_{i_0} ⊂ X. Likewise d_0 maps X_{i_0} × {i_*} into X_{i_1} × {…} by the closed inclusion X_{i_0} ⊂ X_{i_1}. These maps are closed immersions (finite, unramified), not local homeomorphisms, unless the X_i are open (or both open and closed). Only the α(0) = 0 claim (16)/(17) is correct as stated. Grothendieck may have had open subsets in mind at this moment, or meant 'local homeomorphism onto its image'.
Equation numbering: the page labels the first display (15), but (15) was already used on the previous page and the next display is (17), so it should be (16).

ideas.what: Semi-simplicial space ⨿_{i_0≤…≤i_r} X_{i_0} attached to an ordered family of closed subsets, with α^*(x, i_*) = (x, i_* ∘ α)
ideas.modern_name: Bousfield–Kan simplicial replacement of a diagram (its realization is the homotopy colimit); chain-restricted Čech nerve
ideas.usually_credited_to: Bousfield–Kan (1972); Segal (1968) for classifying spaces of coverings
ideas.where_published: Related Čech/hypercovering nerves appear in SGA 4 Exp. V; this precise construction is not known in his published texts

ideas.what: Operators with α(0)=0 are trivial étale coverings whose fibre is the set of flags lifting a given flag (eq. 17); only d_0-type maps involve the inclusions X_{i_0} ⊂ X_{i_1}
ideas.modern_name: In the simplicial replacement, the 'last-vertex/first-vertex' faces and degeneracies are coproduct reindexings, while d_0 uses the functoriality of the diagram

ideas.what: Recovering X from the semi-simplicial system as a colimit/cokernel (next page)
ideas.modern_name: Descent for closed covers / colimit of a closed cover (exact for locally finite closed covers)

missed.claim: Grothendieck's encoding of a filtered/stratified space through a semi-simplicial 'flag nerve' is in substance the Bousfield–Kan replacement. Its interest here is the attempt to make the structure maps étale for a stratified-topos theory. The page itself contains no new result, and the étaleness claim fails for general faces.
missed.quote: on peut dire seulement qu'elles sont des homéom. locales
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Minor. It documents Grothendieck's 1980s approach to stratified topoi via étale semi-simplicial data, which is related in spirit to later exit-path / constructible-sheaf descriptions, but not anticipating them on this page.

deep.surprise_reason: A routine verification about a standard nerve construction (the simplicial replacement of a poset-indexed family of closed subsets), together with a slip about local homeomorphisms. It is of historical interest only as part of the stratified-topos notes.
transcription_corrections: The first label is probably '(16)', not '(15)': (15) is used on the previous page and the next display is (17).
In the line 'des drapeaux de I', a superscript 'i_*' is inserted above: 'des drapeaux i_* de I, de type Δ_r'.
'Quand aux' is Grothendieck's spelling of 'Quant aux'.
